svg.title: Small Geothermal Power Unit - Illustration
svg.desc: Organic Rankine-cycle-style unit. Labels: generator, turbine, condenser, evaporator, recuperator, working-fluid pump. Visible references: 355 kW; hot water 75-105°C; cold water 0-35°C. Equipment illustration, not a complete verified specification table or guaranteed project output.
